name: French Crêpes
author: aeredren on based.cooking

ingredients.item: 30 g butter or 3 tbsp of oil

steps: Mix flour, salt, eggs and melted butter or oil. (In this order to avoid dry flour)
Slowly add milk and beer until the dough becomes fluid enough. (Pouring it from the ladle has to be fluid)
Cook the crêpe in a flat pan, one ladle at a time.

culture.text: A crêpe is a dish made from unleavened batter or dough that is cooked on a frying pan or a griddle. Crêpes are usually one of two varieties: sweet crêpes or savoury crêpes. They are often served with a wide variety of fillings such as cheese, fruit, vegetables, meats, and a variety of spreads. Crêpes can also be flambéed, such as in Crêpes Suzette.
